artifacts.artifactEvidenceNote: The release ZIP embeds 1.10.11.22 while the tagged source project file still declares 1.10.11.21; the immutable archive and release tag supply the runtime identity.
The release ZIP embeds 1.12.0.1 while the tagged source project file still declares 1.12.0.0; the immutable archive and release tag supply the runtime identity.
The upstream manifest labels the Jellyfin 12 entry 1.1.1.0, but the v1.1.0.0 release filename and packaged DLL identity are 1.1.0.0; runtime verification follows the immutable DLL identity.
Upstream meta.json carries an empty assemblies array; materialization completes it with the independently verified Jellyfin.Plugin.Oscars.dll identity.
The Awesome Jellyfin row is named Moonbase while the current repository, package, plugin metadata, and client routes identify the product as Moonfin; the catalog row remains the coverage key.

classificationDefinitions.live-web-interacting-testable: Current public plugin with a local/global Jellyfin Web interaction and a defensible current runtime artifact.
classificationDefinitions.configuration-not-server-plugin: Web-affecting configuration, but not a Jellyfin server plugin package.
classificationDefinitions.live-web-interacting-upstream-incompatib: Live web-affecting plugin whose current package is incompatible with the locked runtimes.
classificationDefinitions.retired-stale-web-plugin: Retired historical web plugin retained only as negative/legacy evidence.
classificationDefinitions.stale-resource-route-upstream-incompatib: Legacy resource-route plugin retained only as quarantine evidence.
classificationDefinitions.live-server-plugin-not-relevant: Live server plugin without a plausible global shell or asset interaction.
classificationDefinitions.auth-paid-or-manual-not-relevant: Manual, paid, or credentialed integration outside this shell compatibility slice.
classificationDefinitions.client-not-server-plugin: Catalog row is a companion client/executable rather than a server plugin.
classificationDefinitions.archived-dead-auth-plugin: Archived authentication plugin with no current runtime campaign.
